dog.description_text: Samantha is a 4 month old, 32 pound Shepherd mix who is spayed, vetted, and full of puppy personality! Her foster loves her sweet, sassy nature, her enthusiasm for toys, and how much she adores her people. She’s either playing hard or snoozing afterward! Smart and eager to learn, Samantha knows “sit” and “stay,” settles in her crate after some initial whining, and is making great progress with potty training, even letting her foster know when she needs to go outside. She’s currently fostered with another dog, though her enthusiastic energy can overwhelm other canine friends who aren't ready for so much energy. She hasn’t been around cats. Samantha is working on all things puppy including calmer greetings and leash manners as she is such a happy and excited girl. With patient guidance, a consistent routine, and plenty of playtime, this loving girl will make a wonderful companion!
dog.name: Samantha
